'''jedimaster Training To Train 1.4''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 MWYHL jedimaster LS 2003 Training 4265.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The fourth incarnation of my vaunted MWYHL deck.

== Strategy ==

Alright, still waiting on Def. Shields...

Cards that I am going to put in...

Bacta Tank

x2 AJR

x2 Qui-Gon With Stick

Alter Combo

Cards I plan on taking out...

Alter

Sai'torr Kal Fas

Qui-Gon Jinn

Qui-Gon's Lightsaber

Electrobinoculars

OTE (maybe?!)

WAYTTPOU

Lemme know if you have an suggestions in that area...

Also need a new starting interrupt in place of STKF...any ideas?

Next strategy...this deck plays just like a reg. MWYHL deck.

*NOTES*

-Train D.O.S.

-Use Control/Tunnel Visons to get cards you need from Force Pile.

-Try to get opponent to grab anything but ICBW. Maybe the C/TV or the AJR

Any suggestions are welcome. Thanks
